info.title: WaterlooWorks Flash Next local API
info.description: Google-authenticated shared listings API. Admin-only refresh with durable WaterlooWorks pacing: within the minimum interval after a run finishes a manual refresh needs explicit confirmation (confirm_recent), while blocks and the rolling budget always refuse. Sequential detail content follows the full listing save. Configure safe HTTPS and the pinned owner bootstrap before opening access.

get.description: Optional display fields for the current verified session only; never cached.
Safe metadata about the caller's agent API token: whether one exists, its hint, creation and last-use times. Never the token.

delete.description: Revoke the caller's agent API token immediately.

post.description: Mint a new agent API token for the caller and return its plaintext exactly once. Any previous token stops working immediately. At most 5 resets per 10 minutes.

get.description: All of the caller's posting states and viewed times.

put.description: Set or clear (null) the caller's state for one saved posting.
Mark one saved posting viewed (keeps the first view time) or clear the mark.

get.description: The caller's Discord new-job alert webhooks: label, hint, enabled state and last delivery result. Never the webhook URL.

post.description: Add a Discord webhook for new-job alerts. The URL is validated, encrypted with the backend key and never returned. At most 10 per account; duplicates are refused.

patch.description: Rename the caller's webhook or turn its alerts on or off.

delete.description: Delete the caller's webhook; returns the remaining list.

post.description: Send a fixed test message to the caller's webhook and record the result. At most 3 tests per minute per account.

409.description: A refresh is already running, or (with the X-WW-Refresh-Recent header) the previous run finished within the minimum interval: resend with confirm_recent=true after asking the admin. Scheduled refreshes never confirm.

X-WW-Refresh-Recent.description: Present only on the confirmable refusal: the previous run's finish time (UTC ISO 8601).

429.description: Ban-risk/rate-limit block or rolling 24-hour request budget; never overridable by confirm_recent.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds until the hard wait ends.

200.description: SSE events named refresh; data is RefreshSnapshot JSON. Reconnect sends current state and up to 200 sanitized logs. Connecting never starts a refresh.

429.description: Per-session or server-wide live stream cap reached.

last_refreshed_at.description: UTC ISO time the saved listings were last observed (the web header's 'Refreshed … ago'); null before the first refresh.

next_scheduled_at.description: UTC ISO time of the next scheduled refresh; null when scheduling is off, has no times or is inactive on this server.

AgentRefreshStatus.title: AgentRefreshStatus

token.title: Token

hint.title: Hint
hint.description: Prefix and last four characters, e.g. wwf_…ab12.

ApiTokenIssued.title: ApiTokenIssued
ApiTokenIssued.description: The plaintext token, returned exactly once; store it now.

hint.title: Hint
hint.description: Prefix and last four characters, e.g. wwf_…ab12.

last_used_at.title: Last Used At
last_used_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 of the latest recorded use (minute resolution).

ApiTokenStatus.title: ApiTokenStatus
ApiTokenStatus.description: Safe metadata only; never the token or its digest.

text.title: Text
text.description: Location context, not proof of the prediction.

hint.title: Hint
hint.description: Last four digits of the webhook ID, e.g. …1234.

last_sent_at.title: Last Sent At
last_sent_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 of the latest successful delivery.

last_status.title: Last Status
last_status.description: Result of the latest delivery attempt; gone means Discord reported the webhook deleted, so it was disabled.

last_error_at.title: Last Error At
last_error_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 of the latest failed delivery.

DiscordWebhook.title: DiscordWebhook
DiscordWebhook.description: Safe metadata only; never the URL, its token or ciphertext.

url.title: Url
url.description: Discord webhook URL: https://discord.com/api/webhooks/<id>/<token> (discordapp.com, ptb. and canary. hosts are normalised).

DiscordWebhookCreate.title: DiscordWebhookCreate
DiscordWebhookCreate.description: A new alert destination; the URL is encrypted and never returned.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Most webhooks one account may add.

available.title: Available
available.description: False when the backend encryption key is not configured, so webhooks cannot be added or delivered.

EmptyRequest.title: EmptyRequest
EmptyRequest.description: Explicit ``{}`` JSON body for session mutations that carry no fields.

formatting.description: Sanitized formatting (paragraphs, lists, bold/italic, http(s)/mailto links, line breaks) for labels of the saved content; null or a missing label means show the plain text. Never HTML.

LinkRun.title: LinkRun
LinkRun.description: Opens in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer" when rendered.

ListBlock.title: ListBlock
ListBlock.description: Each item is a non-empty sequence of blocks (paragraphs or nested lists).

daily_cost_stop_usd.title: Daily Cost Stop Usd
daily_cost_stop_usd.description: Optional rolling 24-hour known-cost stop across runs; null when WW_OPENAI_DAILY_COST_STOP_USD is unset or invalid.

daily_cost_stop_invalid.title: Daily Cost Stop Invalid
daily_cost_stop_invalid.description: WW_OPENAI_DAILY_COST_STOP_USD is set but malformed or out of range; every new OpenAI reservation is refused until it is corrected.

warning.title: Warning
warning.default: Known-cost stop threshold is not a hard monetary cap. In-flight requests can add charges. Unknown usage requires operator review before a new run. Only the 20 most recent runs are listed; older ledger records are retained.

state.title: State
state.description: interested, applied or not_interested; null when unmarked.

viewed_at.title: Viewed At
viewed_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 of the first explicit view mark; null if unviewed.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 of the latest change; null when nothing is stored.

PostingMark.title: PostingMark
PostingMark.description: One user's annotations on one saved posting.

marks.title: Marks
marks.description: The caller's marks keyed by posting ID; unmarked IDs are absent.

state.title: State
state.description: interested, applied or not_interested; null clears the state.

viewed.title: Viewed
viewed.description: true records the first view time (idempotent); false clears it.

message.title: Message
message.description: Reviewed log message with scope and safe arguments; never a token, Duo code, or raw exception.

min_interval_minutes.title: Min Interval Minutes
min_interval_minutes.description: WW_REFRESH_MIN_INTERVAL_MINUTES after a run finishes: scheduled refreshes skip within it; a manual refresh asks for confirmation.

used_24h.title: Used 24H
used_24h.description: Requests counted in the last 24 hours.

next_allowed_at.title: Next Allowed At
next_allowed_at.description: UTC ISO end of the hard wait (block or rolling budget); null when a manual refresh may start now, possibly after confirmation.

last_finished_at.title: Last Finished At
last_finished_at.description: UTC ISO finish time of the most recent finished run, if any.

cooldown_until.title: Cooldown Until
cooldown_until.description: UTC ISO end of the minimum interval after the last finish; null when past. Before it, a manual refresh needs confirm_recent.

blocked_until.title: Blocked Until
blocked_until.description: Active ban-risk/rate-limit block end (UTC ISO), if any.

last_pacing_stop.title: Last Pacing Stop
last_pacing_stop.description: Why the most recent finished run stopped early, if it did.

last_error_category.title: Last Error Category
last_error_category.description: Fixed failure category of the most recent finished run.

RefreshPacingStatus.title: RefreshPacingStatus
RefreshPacingStatus.description: Server pacing policy and rolling usage; no credentials or source data.

confirm_recent.title: Confirm Recent
confirm_recent.description: Admin confirmation to refresh within WW_REFRESH_MIN_INTERVAL_MINUTES of the previous run's finish. Never waives a ban-risk/rate-limit block or the rolling 24-hour request budget.

RefreshRequest.title: RefreshRequest
RefreshRequest.description: Starts one guarded listing-then-content refresh; ``{}`` is the usual body.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Admin toggle persisted in the database.

server_enabled.title: Server Enabled
server_enabled.description: WW_ENABLE_REFRESH=1 and WW_ENABLE_SCHEDULE=1 on this server.

next_run_at.title: Next Run At
next_run_at.description: UTC ISO next run; null unless both switches are on.

failure.description: Scheduled-run failure that turned scheduling off, if any.

RefreshScheduleView.title: RefreshScheduleView
RefreshScheduleView.description: Admin schedule settings; times are Toronto wall-clock HH:MM, sorted.

detail_bursts.title: Detail Bursts
detail_bursts.description: Polite rest breaks the shared WaterlooWorks pacing gate took.

detail_wait_seconds.title: Detail Wait Seconds
detail_wait_seconds.description: Current scheduled rest/retry wait in seconds.

ww_requests.title: Ww Requests
ww_requests.description: WaterlooWorks requests counted for this run: paced requests, retries and counted browser page loads.

ww_request_budget.title: Ww Request Budget
ww_request_budget.description: This run's allowance: min(per-run cap, rolling remaining).

pacing_stop.title: Pacing Stop
pacing_stop.description: Why the run stopped early: a request cap (finished partial, remaining postings wait for the next refresh) or a ban-risk signal from WaterlooWorks (failed; refreshes blocked).

error_category.title: Error Category
error_category.description: Fixed failure category of a failed run.

analysis_provider.title: Analysis Provider
analysis_provider.description: Active AI access mode and model label while extracting.

eta_seconds.title: Eta Seconds
eta_seconds.description: Latest collector-emitted ETA, not a live countdown; null when unestimated.

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Bounded to the latest 200 sanitized events.

next_scheduled_at.title: Next Scheduled At
next_scheduled_at.description: UTC ISO time of the next scheduled refresh; null when scheduling is off, has no times or is inactive on this server.

scheduled_failure.description: Set while scheduling is off after a failed scheduled refresh.

failed_at.title: Failed At
failed_at.description: UTC ISO instant the failed slot was due.

due_at.title: Due At
due_at.description: UTC ISO instant the slot was due.

failed_at.title: Failed At
failed_at.description: UTC ISO time the failed slot was due.

ScheduledFailureNotice.title: ScheduledFailureNotice
ScheduledFailureNotice.description: Member-safe notice: a scheduled refresh failed (no category or run).

StoredListing.title: StoredListing
StoredListing.description:
Allowlisted listing snapshot; unknown field types remain JSON values.

Use model_dump_json(exclude_unset=True) to preserve missing versus null fields.
No raw action, apply control, cookie, or request fields are accepted.

StoredPostingFormatting.title: StoredPostingFormatting
StoredPostingFormatting.description: Per-label sanitized formatting; labels without it show their plain text.

AgentToken.description: Per-user agent token from the account settings (POST /api/account/api-token/reset), sent as `Authorization: Bearer wwf_…`.
